restaurant_name: Alpha Patong Clinic : อัลฟ่า ป่าตอง คลีนิคเวชกรรม
text:
I had a fantastic experience at Alpha Patong Clinic. The staff is incredibly friendly and professional, and what really sets them apart is that they don’t try to sell you treatments. Instead, they focus on what could be done, explaining your options clearly without pressure.

Unlike many places, they don’t push you into making a decision on the spot. After discussing possible treatments, they simply hand you a price list so you can think it over and do your own research before committing—something I really appreciated.

I did a Botox treatment here and have done it for many years in Sweden, so I know how it should be done and what to expect. The doctor was very professional, and her staff made sure I was comfortable throughout. Another big plus is that a follow-up appointment is included in the price. When I missed mine, they immediately rescheduled it without hesitation or complaints.

At my follow-up, I mentioned that I was happy with the results but wondered if more could be done. They carefully examined me and, to my surprise, offered an additional touch-up free of charge to ensure everything looked perfect.

There are a lot of tourist traps in Phuket, unfortunately, but this clinic is the real deal. If you want professional, ethical, and high-quality aesthetic treatments in Phuket, I strongly recommend Alpha Patong Clinic!
